title: Witness Session Submit — payload
description: A participating party submits its presentation bound to the session challenge; the witness's mandatory response delivers the Verifiable Witness Credential. The response is the outcome evidence a VWC presentation must ship.

vp.description: A W3C Verifiable Presentation of the submitting party's own relationship credential material (opaque here), bound to the session's challenge and domain. A presentation not bound to this session is rejected with witness/session/submit:challengeMismatch.

Response.title: Witness Session Submit — response payload
Response.description: The Verifiable Witness Credential, delivered under the REQUIRED proof. This document is the ceremony's terminal success form and the outcome evidence a VWC presentation must ship.

vwc.description: A signed Verifiable Witness Credential (opaque here; its schema belongs to DTG Core Credentials). Its taskContext MUST equal the id of the witness/session document that opened this ceremony — the innermost exchange that attests the witnessing (SPEC.md §4.9.1).
